name: Remapping Phase
definition: A face of a cell of a cluster is defined as a pseudo-boundary face if it is shared by two cells belonging to two different clusters. A pseudo-boundary face may become a boundary face after remapping if it is shared by two cells belonging to two different clusters which are mapped to different processors.
summary: The Remapping Phase is a view-dependent preprocessing step that reassigns data clusters to processors based on current viewing parameters to solve load imbalance and communication overhead.
